The Blackstone headquarters in New York.

David Levine and Giovanni Cutaia take over a division that has gone from the firm’s fastest growing to its slowest.

Steve Schwarzman was concerned. It had been a rough stretch for Blackstone’s real estate division. The market was brutal, and the shooting death of Wesley LePatner at the firm’s New York headquarters nearly a year earlier still weighed heavily on the group.

To try to raise morale, Schwarzman invited top leaders from Blackstone’s real estate business to his Manhattan apartment for dinner in June. The billionaire founder and his handpicked heir apparent, Jon Gray, wanted to see firsthand how they were holding up.
